# Security policy

Please report vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/RockeyRoc/DeepProf/security/advisories/new). Do not include API keys, learner data, answer sheets or raw model outputs in a public issue.

The default Gateway binds to the local loopback interface. The CLI stores application data under the user's DeepProf data directory; provider credentials are handled separately from session events and read-only replay output.

This project is an educational engineering prototype. It is not intended for unsupervised high-stakes decisions or unmanaged collection of student data.
